    • VALUE_CLASSES

      public static final Set<Class<?>> VALUE_CLASSES
      The set of classes accepted as values. Matching is by exact class, so subclasses must be listed explicitly to be accepted.

      • deepCopy(Map, Set)

    • deepCopy

      public static <K,V> Map<K,V> deepCopy(Map<K,V> map, Set<Class<?>> acceptedClasses)
      Returns a deep copy of the map, copying the values of the given classes.

      How each value is copied:

      • Maps (HashMap, LinkedHashMap, TreeMap) and collections (ArrayList, LinkedList, HashSet, LinkedHashSet, TreeSet) are copied into a new instance of the same class, recursively. Tree maps and sets keep their comparator.
      • Properties are copied into a new instance, recursively.
      • Any other accepted value is assumed immutable (scalars, strings, date and time) and is shared, not copied.
      • Values of classes not accepted, such as those stored with Properties.putObject(Object, Object), are shared as is, not copied.
      Map keys are shared, not copied, since keys should be immutable.

      A container referenced more than once is copied once, and the copy is referenced in the same places, so shared and circular references are preserved.

      The top level map does not need to be in the accepted classes, but it must be one of the map classes listed above.

      Type Parameters:
      K - The key type.
      V - The value type.
      Parameters:
      map - The map to copy.
      acceptedClasses - The classes whose values are copied, matched by exact class.
      Returns:
      The deep copy.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If any value, at any depth, is null, or if an accepted map or collection class can not be copied.
